_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,749 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with 197 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.29x; -4% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.14; conservative 2yr +42%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-0.9%/yr (Q3 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +9.8%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +35.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2011-09-02) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.29x (26.1% downside to Bear $14 / +90.1% upside to Bull $36) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 1.79: gap -0.14 [FAIRLY VALUED] | -4% above the EPP floor $20 (13x FY11E $1.51) | Conservative 2-yr case: +41.6% total (+20.8%/yr) | At 12.5x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $25 sits at or below the BASE case; comps -0.3% in Q2 FY11, forward sales +2% (Q3 FY11 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
